companyDescription: Pre-revenue micro-reactor developer (ZEUS, ODIN) · KRONOS MMR construction permit application now formally DOCKETED by the NRC for a University of Illinois site (concrete 2027 review / mid-2027 construction timeline) · New nuclear-powered AI infrastructure LOI with IP3 · $580M cash
priceNote: Self-fetched today (live-prices.json cache dated Aug 13, too stale to use). Down 8.3% since the last report ($17.44 → $16.00) despite genuinely concrete regulatory and strategic progress — the NRC has now DOCKETED (not just 'initiated review of') the KRONOS construction permit application, with a real environmental-review timeline (2027) and construction target (mid-2027).
summary: Two genuinely concrete developments since the last report: the NRC formally docketed the KRONOS construction permit application for a University of Illinois site, with environmental review targeted for 2027 and construction expected mid-2027 — real dates where before there was only 'formal review activities' with no timeline. Second, a Sep 25 non-binding LOI with IP3 Corporation and Cybernetic Intelligence to jointly pursue nuclear-powered AI infrastructure taps directly into the hot AI-datacenter-power theme, a real expansion of the addressable narrative. Needham initiated coverage Sep 21 at Buy, $33 (the first fresh analyst signal since the last report), pulling the 8-analyst consensus to $37.57 (+135%) — still real upside but honestly still below this board's classic 200%+ turbo bar, unchanged from last report. Cash remains exceptional (~$580M), fully removing survival risk. This is a genuine progress update, not a fresh high-conviction pick.

catalysts.name: KRONOS Construction Permit — NRC Docketed
catalysts.description: The NRC has formally docketed the KRONOS micro modular reactor's construction permit application for a University of Illinois site, with environmental review targeted for 2027 and construction expected mid-2027 — a concrete procedural advance and the first real timeline this thesis has had.

catalysts.name: Nuclear-Powered AI Infrastructure LOI (IP3 / Cybernetic Intelligence)
catalysts.description: Non-binding letter of intent (Sep 25) to jointly pursue nuclear-powered AI infrastructure projects, positioning NNE as a 'preferred provider' of nuclear technology for AI datacenters — a real expansion of the addressable market narrative beyond micro-reactors alone.

catalysts.name: Advanced Fuel Transportation / HALEU Logistics
catalysts.description: Nearest-term path to actual revenue — HALEU logistics targeted for 2027-2028 through the Advanced Fuel Transportation subsidiary, well ahead of any reactor commercialization.

risks: Real upside (consensus +135%) still doesn't clear this board's typical 200%+ bar — unchanged assessment from the last report, now with a broader 8-analyst sample (Needham's $33 initiation is more conservative than the prior average and pulled the consensus down slightly)

Genuinely pre-revenue with the nearest commercial revenue path (HALEU logistics) still 1-2 years out — even with docketing, the KRONOS construction-permit review timeline (2027 review, mid-2027 construction) is a multi-year story, not a near-term binary
The IP3/Cybernetic Intelligence AI-infrastructure tie-up is a non-binding LOI, not a signed contract — real, but early-stage

Stock is down 8.3% since the last report despite genuinely positive regulatory and strategic news — a mild version of the pattern seen elsewhere on this board where good news isn't being fully rewarded

Sector-wide SMR/advanced-nuclear sentiment has been volatile in 2026 on DOE loan-program news that favors large reactors over small modular designs — a real headwind for the whole peer group, unchanged
